references.text: The same chapter repeats the warning that the land will vomit out its inhabitants if they defile themselves with the same sins
Repeats the theme that the land will vomit out the people if they do not keep God's laws and statutes
Describes how bloodshed makes the land unclean, and that the Lord dwells in the midst of the land
Explains that God drives out the nations because of their wickedness, not because of Israel's righteousness
Joshua warns Israel that God will no longer drive out the nations if Israel mixes with them
Ezra describes how the land was made unclean by the abominations of the peoples, and quotes the warning not to give daughters to them
Isaiah describes how the earth is defiled by its inhabitants because they have broken the laws and the everlasting covenant
Jeremiah accuses Israel of having made God's land unclean and turning his inheritance into an abomination
God will punish the people double because they have defiled the land with their abominations
Ezekiel describes how Israel made the land unclean with their conduct and deeds, and God poured out his wrath on them
